```{r}
#| label: setup

# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Data and resources
source(here::here("data/clean-data/constants.R")) # Constants
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sed_2022_geometries.Rda")) # SED Summer Hill boundary
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sa1_maps_sh_geometries.Rda")) # SA1 Summer Hill boundaries
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_age5.Rda")) # Age by SA1
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tallyroom/nsw_la_2023.Rda")) # Election results by polling place
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tallyroom/polling_places.Rda")) # Polling place locations

# Merge the SA1 geometries to the tablebuilder data
sa1_maps_sh_age <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_age5[, c("sa1_code_2021", "Total")],
            by = "sa1_code_2021")

# Define the colour palette
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "Greys",
  domain = sa1_maps_sh$Total
)


# Tidy election results
df <- nsw_la_2023 |>
  filter(district_name == "Summer Hill") |>
  group_by(pp_name) |>
  mutate(
    pct = votes/sum(votes),
    party_code = factor(party_code, levels = c("ALP", "LIB", "AJP", "SUS", "INF", "GRN"))
    )

df2 <- df |>
  select(pp_name, party_code, votes) |>
  filter(party_code %in% c("GRN", "ALP")) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = pp_name, names_from = party_code, values_from = votes) |>
  left_join(polling_places, by = "pp_name") |>
  filter(! is.na(latitude))


```


## Election boundaries and polling places

```{r}

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |> 
    addPolygons(
    data = sa1_maps_sh_age,
    fillColor = ~pal(Total),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", sa2_name_2021, "</b><hr>",
      "<em>", sa1_code_2021, "</em><br>",
      "Pop: ", scales::comma(Total))
    )  |>
  addPolylines(data = sed_2022, color = "black", weight = 5) |> 
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = df2,
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = ~sqrt(ALP / pi) / 2,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillColor = "#E13940",
    fillOpacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = df2,
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = ~sqrt(GRN / pi) / 2,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillColor = "#39B54A",
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", pp_name, "</b><hr>",
      "<b>ALP: </b>", scales::comma(ALP), "<br>",
      "<b>GRN: </b>", scales::comma(GRN)
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    data = sa1_maps_sh_age,
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~Total,
    title = "Total"
  )


```


## 2023 State Election Results by Polling Place

```{r}

grn_order <- df |>
  filter(party_code == "GRN") |>
  arrange(votes) |>
  pull(pp_name)

ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = df |> mutate(pp_name = factor(pp_name, levels = grn_order)),
    aes(x = votes, y = pp_name, fill = party_code)
  ) +
  geom_text(data = df |> filter(party_code == "GRN"),
            aes(x = -20, y = pp_name, label = paste0(round(100 * pct), "%")),
            size = 6/.pt, show.legend = FALSE, hjust = 1, color = "#39B54A") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = party_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(NULL, labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_y_discrete(NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = 'none',
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())


```
